title: Merced Residents Named in Lawsuit Against Motorola Solutions Over License Plate Reader Data Sharing
summary: Two Merced residents filed a proposed class-action lawsuit against Motorola Solutions alleging its ALPR technology collected California vehicle-location data that was improperly shared with federal and out-of-state agencies. The suit follows Merced PD's April disclosure that an internal review found its Vigilant/Motorola ALPR system had been configured to share data with federal agencies, connections it says have since been disabled.

key_quotes.quote: The lawsuit also alleges that license plate reader data collected in California was improperly shared with federal and out-of-state law enforcement agencies.
